description: Canonical Orchestra V3 Capability-to-Resource Execution Graph mapping task archetypes across Discovery, Synthesis, Implementation, and QA phases.

premium-website.name: Premium Creative Website
premium-website.description: Award-winning editorial or agency landing page with sophisticated typography, curated motion, and high aesthetic density.
anti_patterns: Inter or Space Grotesk in creative headlines
Generic 3-column equal card layouts
Neon purple AI gradient backgrounds
Pure black #000000 surfaces without chromatic depth
trigger_conditions: A stranger, client, or recruiter is the audience
The brief names a brand, studio, agency, restaurant, or launch page
Marketing or conversion copy is the primary content
The request asks for a distinctive look rather than a working form
A showcase carries commerce alongside the story — a shop or checkout bolted onto a brand page
skip_conditions: The surface is behind a login and only staff will see it
The request is a bugfix, refactor, or backend change
The product is a dense data tool — route to saas-dashboard or b2b-portal
The human said "skip the lab" and only wants the page wired up
A 3D scene is the point rather than the decoration — route to 3d-portfolio

3d-portfolio.name: Interactive 3D WebGL Portfolio
3d-portfolio.description: Spatial WebGL digital showcase featuring Three.js/R3F scenes, custom shaders, and interactive camera orbits.
anti_patterns: Uncapped framerate animation loops causing CPU thermal throttling
Missing mobile fallback for low-end WebGL GPUs
Blocking main thread during 3D asset initialization
trigger_conditions: The brief names WebGL, Three.js, R3F, shaders, or a 3D scene
Camera movement or spatial navigation is part of the concept
The showcase itself is the product, not a page describing a product
skip_conditions: No low-end or reduced-motion fallback is acceptable to the human
3D is decorative and a flat hero would carry the same message
The target is a low-power device or an audience on poor connections
The brief is a portfolio but never mentions depth, scene, or motion — route to premium-website
Physics simulation is the point rather than presentation — route to physics-canvas

operator-hud.name: Operator HUD & Mission Control
operator-hud.description: High-density telemetry dashboard, AI cockpit, and operator control room inspired by Lyra (dark crimson, monospace figures, zero generic cards).
anti_patterns: Generic shadcn card layouts or template UI kits
Light mode or pure white background panels
Floating decorative gradients without data utility
Proportional fonts on live fluctuating data values
trigger_conditions: A single operator monitors live state and acts on it
The brief names telemetry, cockpit, mission control, or a command surface
Information density matters more than whitespace
Monospace figures and always-on status are expected
The brief describes watching servers, jobs, or streams while they run
skip_conditions: The audience is many casual users rather than one trained operator
The data is reported after the fact — route to saas-dashboard
The brief expects a component kit look; this route is bespoke by definition
Administrative CRUD is the real job — route to b2b-portal

b2b-portal.name: B2B Enterprise Portal & SaaS
b2b-portal.description: Structured corporate management dashboard, transactional workflows, accessible tables, and multi-tenant administrative interfaces.
anti_patterns: Non-accessible form elements failing WCAG 2.1 AA
Unresponsive data tables that cause horizontal screen clipping
Slow unpaginated table queries without skeleton loaders
trigger_conditions: Authenticated users perform recurring transactional work
The brief names admin, tenants, roles, billing, or approvals
Tables, forms, and workflow states are the core surface
Accessibility and predictability outrank visual novelty
skip_conditions: The page is public marketing — route to premium-website
The value is charts and trends rather than records — route to saas-dashboard
The human explicitly asked for an award-winning visual treatment
There is no authentication and no multi-user concept

academic-reader.name: Academic Reader & Research Paper Viewer
academic-reader.description: Distraction-free reading environment, mathematical typesetting, editorial footnotes, and zero-reflow layout engine.
anti_patterns: Lines longer than 75 characters causing reading fatigue
Low contrast text below 7:1 for continuous body reading
Layout shifts during font or LaTeX equation loading
trigger_conditions: Long-form prose is the product and reading comfort is the metric
The brief names papers, arXiv, footnotes, citations, or math typesetting
Reflow, measure, and vertical rhythm are explicit concerns
skip_conditions: The content is short marketing copy
Interaction or dashboards dominate the surface
The brief wants heavy motion; this route protects reading

micro-interactions.name: Sensory Micro-Interactions & Gestures
micro-interactions.description: Tactile interactive UI components with physically calibrated spring curves, active press feedback, and integrated haptics.
anti_patterns: Animating layout-triggering properties (width, height, top, margin)
Overly sluggish springs with duration > 400ms on button clicks
Missing active state press compression (scale 0.98)
trigger_conditions: The unit of work is a component, not a page
The brief names feel, tactility, spring, press feedback, or haptics
An existing UI is being refined rather than created
skip_conditions: No product surface exists yet to attach the interaction to
The whole page or product needs a direction first
Motion has no stated purpose — do not animate to look busy
The platform is native mobile — route to mobile-app

physics-canvas.name: Interactive Physics Canvas & 2D Simulation
physics-canvas.description: Interactive WebGL/Canvas games, trigonometry calculations, particle collisions, and rigid-body simulations.
anti_patterns: DOM-based physics calculations instead of Canvas/WebGL context
Frame rate tied to wall-clock time instead of delta time (dt)
Missing canvas DPI resolution scaling on Retina viewports
trigger_conditions: Collision, gravity, particles, or rigid bodies are simulated
The brief names a game, playground, or interactive simulation
Per-frame computation drives the visuals
skip_conditions: The motion is scripted presentation rather than simulated behaviour
A CSS or timeline animation achieves the same result
The scene is a spatial showcase without simulation — route to 3d-portfolio

saas-dashboard.name: Modern SaaS Analytics Dashboard
saas-dashboard.description: Interactive metrics dashboard with real-time KPI graphs, filtration controls, and responsive grid layouts.
anti_patterns: Pie charts with more than 5 slices
Unlabeled axes or missing tooltip hover coordinate snaps
trigger_conditions: Metrics, KPIs, charts, or trends are the primary content
The brief names reporting, analytics, or an overview screen
Users filter and compare rather than transact
A school, clinic, or internal management tool needs its numbers surfaced
skip_conditions: The screens are records and forms rather than charts — route to b2b-portal
The surface is live operational control — route to operator-hud
The page is public marketing — route to premium-website

mobile-app.name: Native-Feeling Mobile Web Experience
mobile-app.description: Touch-first mobile web experience adhering to Apple HIG and Android Material 3 with native vibration and gesture navigation.
anti_patterns: Tap targets smaller than 44x44px
Horizontal viewport overflow causing unintentional horizontal panning
Double-tap zoom not disabled on interactive touch targets
trigger_conditions: The target is iOS, Android, Expo, or React Native
Touch, gesture, or device haptics are part of the design
Platform conventions (HIG, Material 3) constrain the layout
skip_conditions: The target is a responsive website that merely works on phones
No device capability is used and no store build is planned
The brief is a desktop-first dense tool

security-audit.name: Automated Security Audit & Hardening
security-audit.description: Deep vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST analysis, dependency auditing, and attack surface minimization.
anti_patterns: Committing hardcoded secrets or environment variables
Disabling CORS checks or Content Security Policy headers
trigger_conditions: The job is to find or fix vulnerabilities in your own application
The brief names SAST, DAST, pentest, dependency audit, or attack surface
Secrets, authorization, or input handling are under review
skip_conditions: The target is not owned by the human — never scan someone else's system
The request is a feature build; security review is a later gate, not this route
The finding is a plain bug with no security consequence

reverse-engineering.name: Reference URL Reverse Engineering
reverse-engineering.description: Extraction of design systems, color palettes, typographic scales, and DOM layouts from user-supplied URLs.
anti_patterns: Wholesale scraping of copyrighted intellectual property
Copying proprietary SVG logos without explicit authorization
trigger_conditions: The human supplied a specific URL to learn from
The goal is to extract tokens, type scale, or layout rules into a design note
A reference needs to become a documented system before any build
skip_conditions: No concrete URL was named — this is not a browsing route
The intent is to copy branding, assets, copy, or source rather than principles
A direction already exists and only needs implementing
